posts.tagline: Offline OCR, spreadsheets, SQL, reports and more - no cloud
posts.description: Most OCR and "PDF-to-Excel" tools are web apps, your documents go to someone's server. VadeKit runs the whole pipeline on your machine. Drop a scanned PDF: on-device OCR extracts the text, layout and tables. Each table opens as a spreadsheet with formulas. Query across files with an offline SQL engine, chart it, and export a PDF report, no uploads. One toolkit, organised by task not by the library that powers it. No telemetry, no AI API. One-time purchase; Windows, macOS, Linux.

posts.name: SmartPack
posts.tagline: Lossless archiving. Zero dependencies.
posts.description: SmartPack is a dependency-free lossless archiver for Ubuntu, built entirely with Python’s standard library. It creates its ownspk format and adapts compression to the data, combining content-aware codec selection, cross-file block deduplication, solid packing for small files, and sparse zero-block handling. Archives include per-block SHA-256 verification and safe extraction checks, with auto, fast, balanced, and max modes.

posts.name: WebPrims
posts.tagline: Learn Python programming in amritsar
posts.description: Python training in Amritsar at WebPrims. Learn Python from basics to async microservices, AI pipelines and deployment, with real projects and mentoring.

posts.tagline: Free local pick tracker for the Build-A-Bucket NBA game
posts.description: A free, independent companion for Build-A-Bucket players. Track ten picks on a local board, compare Guard and Big attributes, review visible grades, and export your runs as JSON. Includes dated guides and a documented ten-pick, 79 OVR example. No signup is needed; your runs stay in your browser. Not affiliated with the official game or the NBA.

posts.description: Database, auth, auto-generated API, realtime, storage, cronjob, frontends and backends. One platform, one CLI, one bill.

posts.name: WorkHive HQ
posts.tagline: The 3D workspace that runs your entire company
posts.description: WorkHive HQ is a 3D virtual workspace built to replace the scattered tools remote teams rely on. Walk around a persistent virtual office, meet teammates through proximity voice, and manage HR, recruitment, payroll, finance, tasks, support tickets, shifts, OKRs, and performance—all in one place. It’s not another video-call grid. It’s a complete digital headquarters for running a modern company.

posts.name: Boothly — Retro Photo Strips for iPhone
posts.tagline: A tiny retro photo booth for parties and weddings
posts.description: Boothly turns three quick iPhone photos into a retro strip people actually want to keep. Start from a QR code or App Clip, choose a theme, and share the finished memory without making guests learn another social network.

posts.description: ZVG Melder tracks every foreclosure auction published by German courts and reads the official 30-60 page appraisal for you. Risks arrive sorted by class, each critical finding backed by a verbatim quote from the source document. Free alerts when a date moves.

posts.name: Prospectio.ai
posts.tagline: Prospectio automates B2B LinkedIn and email outreach
posts.description: Prospectio is a B2B outreach platform that runs LinkedIn and email sequences from first contact through to a booked meeting. It fits small and mid sized sales teams at software development, SaaS, AI, IT services, recruitment and outsourcing companies across Europe and North America. The typical user is a founder or head of sales carrying a pipeline target without a full team of sales development reps behind them.

posts.name: DemoShots
posts.tagline: Turn screen recordings into product stories
posts.description: Create product demos with a beginning, a walkthrough, and a clear next step. Record your product in Chrome, add slides to set the scene, and use text overlays, zooms, and click highlights to explain what matters. Trim pauses, adjust the framing, and export an MP4 or WebM—all on your device, with no account required.

posts.name: Poptimum
posts.tagline: A daily optimization puzzle
posts.description: Poptimum is a daily puzzle game about packing cute fridge magnets as tightly as possible. Every day brings a fresh set of colorful magnets and a new shape to fill. Drag, rotate, and arrange them to squeeze out every bit of empty space, then see how your solution stacks up against players around the world. Play once a day, improve your packing, and see how close you can get to the world’s best score.

posts.name: PickXI: 1v1 Fantasy Cricket
posts.tagline: Real-time fantasy cricket app | live draft & skill-based app
posts.description: A 1v1 fantasy cricket draft where every player can have only one owner. Draft your Playing XI against a friend or rival, one player at a time, with 30 seconds to pick. Once a player is taken, they're gone from your opponent's board. Play upcoming live matches or draft classic matches from cricket history. No shared pools, no identical teams — just cricket knowledge, strategy and nerve.

posts.name: Doorstock
posts.tagline: Offline inventory and job tracking for garage door techs
posts.description: Doorstock tracks parts, low-stock alerts, and a job pipeline (Lead to Paid) for garage-door installers and small trade contractors. No account, no sign-in, no network requests. Everything stays on your device. Mac App Store live now.

posts.name: Pace Glass
posts.tagline: Pace Glass | Custom, Auto & Commercial Glass Solutions
posts.description: From elegant shower doors and custom mirrors to storefronts and window glass, Pace Glass delivers expert craftsmanship, dependable service, and glass solutions built to last in Texarkana.

posts.name: HideMyShare
posts.tagline: Hide any window from screen shares & recordings
posts.description: HideMyShare hides any app window from screen shares, recordings and streams while keeping it fully visible to you. Pick your private windows (chats, messengers, personal mail) and they vanish from Zoom, Teams, Google Meet, Discord, OBS and every other capture - hidden at the Windows rendering level no overlay involved. It even hides IME candidate windows. Free 7-day trial, no account, one-time purchase.

posts.name: Mirasonic
posts.tagline: YouTube Music in the Subsonic client you already use
posts.description: Mirasonic is a free, self-hosted Subsonic server that makes YouTube Music searchable and playable in the client you already use. Your playlists, stars and listening history stay on your machine—no Google account or cookies.

posts.name: ClipTempo
posts.tagline: Change video speed. Keep it local.
posts.description: ClipTempo is a simple Mac app for changing video speed and exporting the result. Preserve natural audio pitch, process everything locally, and keep your videos off the cloud. Free to use, with Pro batch processing and saved presets.

posts.name: MGToolbox
posts.tagline: Fast, free in-browser file tools & private on-device AI
posts.description: Compress photos, merge PDFs, trim audio, transcribe speech, format JSON, and decode JWTs. Files are processed on your device — never uploaded to a server.

posts.name: Axion Cyber — Scan. Detect. Protect.
posts.tagline: Detect scams before they cost you.”
posts.description: Axion Cyber — modern cybersecurity for individuals and small businesses. Scan links, messages, images and WiFi for threats.

posts.name: ZalithID
posts.tagline: Your complete guide & toolkit for Minecraft Java on Android
posts.description: ZalithID is a free resource hub for Minecraft Java Edition on Android via Zalith Launcher 2. Beyond in-depth guides on mods, shaders, and launcher comparisons, it includes practical tools most fan sites skip entirely: instant UUID lookup, a skin viewer & downloader, live server status checker, and a Minecraft color-code copier (also shipped as a Chrome extension). No login, no clutter, no fake download buttons — just the guides and tools Android Minecraft players actually need, free.

posts.name: xMailman
posts.tagline: A one-binary, self-hosted mailing list manager.
posts.description: A one-binary, self-hosted mailing list manager. Manage mailing lists, subscriptions, archives, and moderation from a single static binary. A modern, self-contained alternative to GNU Mailman.

posts.name: Frost Rank Password Generator
posts.tagline: Strong passwords, passphrases & PINs — 100% client-side
posts.description: A free password generator that goes beyond random characters — pick Password, Passphrase, or PIN mode, and get a live entropy score (bits) plus estimated offline crack-time for whatever you generate. Runs 100% in your browser via Web Crypto API's crypto.getRandomValues() (never Math.random()), with unbiased rejection sampling. Nothing you generate is ever sent to a server. Part of Frost Rank — free SEO & dev tools, no signup, no ad clutter.

posts.name: Word Association Now
posts.tagline: AirPlay word association that turns your TV into a game show
posts.description: Word Association Now turns the classic word-chain game into a spectator-friendly party experience. Your iPhone or iPad acts as the controller while an AirPlay-connected TV or Mac displays the prompts for the whole room — no more crowding around a phone. It has a massive, constantly-changing word library so no two games repeat, adjustable timers from Relaxed to Rapid Fire, and a strict privacy-first design: no ads, no accounts, no data tracking, no subscription required.

posts.name: MediMate
posts.tagline: Taking care of your daily doses so you don't have to.
posts.description: Forgetting a dose shouldn't cost you your peace of mind. Medimate turns messy prescription routines into effortless daily rhythm for Android users. Built with intelligent alerts and flexible scheduling, it acts as a quiet safety net in your pocket. We’d love your feedback to help us improve! (Note: Medimate is an independent memory aid, not an officially verified medical tool, and may not be 100% accurate).
